title: Iterative circuit reduction bound with Chernoff tails
statement:
Let $c$ be a Boolean circuit on $n \ge 1$ variables of depth at most $d$, size at most $s$, and maximum fan-in at most $w$, where $d \ge 2$ and $s, w, l \ge 1$, and fix a threshold $t$. Apply a Bernoulli random restriction with parameter
\[
  \delta = \frac{1}{40w}\left(\frac{1}{40l}\right)^{d-2},
\]
so that each variable is left free with probability $\delta$ and otherwise fixed to $\mathtt{false}$ or $\mathtt{true}$ with equal probability. Then the probability that the restricted function $x \mapsto c(\rho.\mathrm{extend}\,x)$ has decision-tree depth exceeding $t$ satisfies
\[
  s\left(\tfrac12\right)^{l} + \left(\tfrac12\right)^{t}
  + s\,\exp\!\left(-\frac{n}{120w}\right)
  + s\,\exp\!\left(-\frac{n}{120l}\right)
\]
as an upper bound.
hypotheses_covered: depth of c at most d
size of c at most s
maximum fan-in of c at most w
restriction parameter equals composedDelta(w, l, d)
event: restricted function has decision-tree depth > t
replaced:
Let $c$ be a circuit on $n$ variables with $n > 0$, depth at most $d$, size at most
$s$, and fan-in at most $w$, where $d \ge 2$ and $s, w, l > 0$. Under a Bernoulli($\delta$)
random restriction $\rho$ with $\delta = \mathrm{composedDelta}\,w\,l\,d$, the probability
that the restricted function has decision-tree depth exceeding $t$ is bounded by
\[
  s \cdot \left(\tfrac{1}{2}\right)^l + \left(\tfrac{1}{2}\right)^t
  + s \cdot \exp\!\left(-\tfrac{n}{120 w}\right)
  + s \cdot \exp\!\left(-\tfrac{n}{120 l}\right).
\]
The exponential Chernoff tails vanish as $n \to \infty$.
